name: Oddity
source:
The main character (Ivan). Haunted by strangeness. Vanya woke up in the forest and saw a strange thing. It gave him an amulet, but only you choose whether he takes it or not!

[from [url=https://tallor-name.itch.io/oddity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角（伊万）。被陌生感所困扰。瓦尼娅在森林里醒来，看到了一件奇怪的事情。它给了他一个护身符，但只有你可以选择他是否接受！

[来自[url=https://tallor-name.itch.io/oddity]itch.io[/url]]
